bio: While away the day with a quintessential Afternoon Tea at Burleigh Court Hotel, an intimate Grade II listed manor house right in the heart of the Cotswolds.  Bursting with country charm, Burleigh Court Hotel offers panoramic views across the stunning landscape of Stroud. Afternoon Tea is served in the Burleigh Court Restaurant, surrounded by delightful oak-panelled walls and overlooking the tranquil Golden Valley.  Afternoon Tea features a selection of scones and cakes which are prepared by the in-house pastry chef. In lieu of sandwiches Afternoon Tea features homemade savoury treats such as sausage rolls, scotch eggs, and charcuterie.  Burleigh Court Hotel is located in Stroud Valley, right in the heart of the Cotswolds. It is just 10 minutes from Stroud train station by car and 30 minutes from Gloucester city centre.
